en.headline: HKEX launches 5-year China Government Bond Futures today
en.dek: The first offshore China Government Bond futures contract begins trading on the Hong Kong exchange, giving investors a new tool to manage interest-rate risk on mainland bonds.
body: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited began trading in 5-year China Government Bond Futures on Monday, the first such offshore contract offered in the city.

The Securities and Futures Commission had earlier set the target launch date of 3 August 2026. HKEX said the product complements Bond Connect and Swap Connect and forms part of its growing suite of China-related risk-management tools.

HKEX Chairman Carlson Tong described the debut as an important milestone for the city’s fixed-income and currencies ecosystem. Chief Executive Officer Bonnie Y Chan said the futures would help investors manage interest-rate risks more efficiently and support Hong Kong’s role as the world’s leading offshore renminbi hub.

International holdings of onshore bonds in the China Interbank Bond Market have risen from about RMB 0.8 trillion in mid-2017 to around RMB 3.2 trillion by the end of May 2026, according to figures cited by the exchange.

zh.headline: 港交所今日推出五年期中國國債期貨
zh.dek: 香港交易所今日起買賣首隻離岸中國國債期貨合約，為投資者提供管理內地債券利率風險的新工具。
body: 香港交易及結算所有限公司今日（周一）正式推出五年期中國國債期貨，成為本港首隻相關離岸合約。
證監會早前公布目標推出日期為2026年8月3日。港交所表示，產品與債券通及互換通相輔相成，進一步豐富其中國相關風險管理工具系列。
港交所主席唐家成形容推出國債期貨是固定收益及貨幣產品生態圈的重要里程碑。行政總裁陳翊庭表示，期貨有助投資者更有效管理利率風險，鞏固香港作為全球首要離岸人民幣樞紐的地位。
港交所引述數據顯示，國際投資者持有中國銀行間債券市場在岸債券的規模，已由2017年中約人民幣0.8萬億元，上升至2026年5月底約人民幣3.2萬億元。
